title: NP-Completeness of the Minimum Circuit Size Problem (MCSP)
exact_target: Is finding whether a complete Boolean truth table has a small circuit NP-hard under ordinary deterministic many-one reductions?

sources.citation: Halley Goldberg, Mandar Juvekar, and Valentine Kabanets, Non-Levin NP-Hardness of Implicit MCSP and PAC Learning under Few Assumptions, ECCC TR26-091, Introduction, printed p. 3 (2026).
